title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1967-10-22

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1967 show featuring the debut “The Other One” and soaring Lovelight moments.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this remastered soundboard recording, calling it surprisingly clear and clean for a ’67 source. The performance is lauded as one of the year’s best, driven by an explosive first‑ever rendition of The Other One, a special Lovelight, and a marathon “That’s It” that keeps the energy at peak throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 4‑5 stars and consistently praise both the musical performance (standout jams, debut The Other One) and the pristine soundboard recording; the large number of detailed comments gives a solid basis for a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered soundboard is described as crisp, clean, and amazingly clear for a 1967 source; no drop‑outs or mixing issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy flow with a tight early set that rolls into laid‑back moments before launching into extended jams; the band maintains momentum throughout, delivering an unforgettable Anthem‑era experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for shredding guitar work and “smoking hot” tone.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ on The Other One is highlighted as top‑notch, showcasing early Anthem‑era keyboard brilliance.
